benefit: A Miku-style MAD for OpenAlice's mascot Alice: the one-person Wall Street who researches, keeps every trade on record and waits for your nod.
proofAction: Alice is held on screen like a Vocaloid MV illustration while the lyrics, graphics and OpenAlice's own interface move around her on the 160 BPM grid.
reference: reference.md (seven Vocaloid MVs studied in scratch research: Vampire, KING, Hibana, God-ish, Rabbit Hole, Mesmerizer, Telepathy)
